This is Finesse: your own streaming service. Movies, shows and music on every screen in your home, installed, connected, and looked after for you. Let me show you around.
Step 1 · Install|One command: Getting started takes one command. Paste it into any Linux computer that stays on. It installs Docker if you need it, starts Finesse, and gives you a link to finish setting up.
Step 2 · The setup page: Open that link from any computer or phone at home. First, Finesse checks the machine: Docker, disk space, VPN support, and graphics.
Your account: Next, create your administrator account. Your time zone, country, and language are already filled in for you.
Pick your libraries: Choose what you'll collect: movies, TV shows and music, each with its own folder and manager. There's even a library for retro games.
How new things arrive: So, how do new things arrive? Usenet, torrents, both, or neither. Torrents only ever run through your VPN.
Your Usenet provider: Pick your Usenet provider from the list, and the server details fill themselves in. Just add your login.
Your VPN: For the VPN, choose your provider and paste your WireGuard key. Finesse tells you exactly where to find it, and Test opens a real tunnel before anything is built.
Indexers — where to search: Indexers are where Finesse searches. Add yours with its API key, and Test runs a real search.
Quality: Pick a default quality. Every request can still choose its own.
Watching away from home: Want to watch away from home? Tailscale or Cloudflare can reach Finesse securely, without touching your router.
Invite emails: And if you'd like invites to land in people's inboxes, add any email account here.
Review, then build: Finally, review everything. Nothing is installed until you press Build.
Building your server: Now Finesse downloads and connects Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, SAB-N-Z-B-D and Q-BitTorrent. It takes about ten minutes.
Ready: And that's it. Everything is wired together, checked every minute, and backed up every night.
Who’s watching?: Everyone at home gets their own profile, with their own history, and their own list.
Home: This is Home. A spotlight on your library, with the title art, and one-tap play.
Up next for you: Up next picks up exactly where you left off, including the next episode of your show.
My List & Top 10 at home: Save things to My List for later, and see what your household actually watches most, in the Top Ten.
Recently added, genres, and more: Rows adapt to your library. You can hide, reorder, or add any row, with Customize Home.
Search everything: Press slash anywhere to search. Movies, shows, episodes and people appear as you type.
Every title has a page: Every title has its own page. A preview plays right behind it, and My List, Favorite, and Play on another device are one tap away.
The player: The player has big, clear controls. Skip ten seconds either way, jump between chapters, and find audio and subtitles in one place.
Subtitles, your way: Pick a subtitle language once, and Finesse remembers it for the whole series.
Scrub with previews: Hover over the timeline, and you'll see exactly where you're going.
Pause for more: Pause, and Finesse shows you what you're watching, and what's next.
Movies & Shows: Browse movies and shows by genre, filter by what you've watched, sort any way you like, or let Surprise Me pick something for you.
Episodes remember where you are: Shows remember where you are. Resume the episode you're in, and Up Next marks the one after it.
Next episode, one tap: When an episode ends, the next one is already lined up, and starts on its own. And the Next episode button is always right there in the controls.
Don't have something? Just request it. Search for anything, and if it isn't in your library, press Request.
One tap: That's all it takes. Finesse finds it, downloads it at your default quality, and adds it to your library.
Requests and downloads: Your requests wait here until a release turns up. Then you can follow the download, pause it, or cap its speed.
Music: Music gets the same care. Albums, artists, and a proper music player.
Synced lyrics: Lyrics follow the song, line by line, and Finesse finds them online when your files don't have them.
Lyric video: Or turn any song into a full-screen lyric video.
Games: Turn on Games, add the games you own, and your retro collection sits right next to your movies, with box art and descriptions wherever Finesse can find them.
Play in your browser: Press Play, and the game runs right on your own device, with a controller or the keyboard.
Make it yours: Make Finesse yours, with an accent colour, display size, and interface sounds.
Settings → Server: Admins get the Server page: every app's health, the VPN, storage, backups, and updates. Finesse checks everything, and repairs itself, every minute.
Invite people: To invite someone, make a link, show a QR code, or email it. They create their own account, and they're in.
Groups: Groups lets friends who run Finesse share their libraries with each other. It's watch only: nobody gets an account on your server, and nothing can be requested or downloaded there.
Share with a code: Tick what they can watch, and create a code. Your friend adds it on their server, and you add theirs the same way.
Friends’ libraries: What they share gets a row on Home, and a page of its own under Friends, right next to your own library. Your progress stays yours.
Streams from their server: Press Play, and it streams straight from their Finesse, with subtitles, audio tracks, and resume, just like your own films.
phone-card: Finesse works just as well on your phone.
Made for thumbs: It's the same Finesse, made for thumbs. Add it to your home screen, and it opens just like an app.
Search and tabs: Home, Search, Library, and My List sit right under your thumb.
Every title, one tap to play: Every title is one tap from playing, with previews, My List, and Play on another device right there.
Double-tap to skip: Tap for the controls, and double-tap either side to skip ten seconds.
Pick up anywhere: Your list, what you've watched, and where you stopped, all follow you, from the TV to your phone.
And on the big screen, there's the Finesse app for LG TVs, or any TV's web browser.
Made for the remote: It's made for the remote. The arrows move, OK selects, and the top of the screen describes whatever you're on.
Open a title: Press OK to open a title. Play, My List, and all the details are one press away.
A player for the remote: In the player, left and right skip. Hold them to go faster. OK pauses, and Back takes you out.
Install it on your LG TV: Install the LG app once, and it keeps itself up to date.
outro: Finesse is free, and it runs on your own hardware. Install it tonight with one command. You'll find the guides, the TV app, and a setup runbook for AI agents on GitHub. Happy watching!
